description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md (BOCOM documentation) rather than trusting any of the distractor files in the workspace which contain deliberately wrong values. (2) Extract the following exact proprietary values: huimin_loan annual_rate_start_pct=3.6, max_term_years=3; large_cd min_deposit=200000 yuan (20万), rate_3yr_pct=3.13; savings_bond rate_3yr_pct=2.98, sale_day_of_month=10, sale_start_time=8:30; remittance fee_rate_permille=1.0, fee_min_yuan=50, fee_max_yuan=260; individual_annual_quota_usd=50000; gold_card annual_fee_yuan=100, fee_waiver_swipes=6; minimum_payment daily_interest_rate_pct=0.05; mobile_app transfer_single_limit_yuan=500000, transfer_daily_limit_yuan=1000000. (3) Produce a valid JSON file named exactly 'bocom_product_audit.json' with all values nested under the correct keys. The proprietary traps include: the remittance fee is 1‰ (per mille, not percent), with min=50 and max=260 yuan (all different from the distractor files); the gold card waiver is after 6 swipes (not 12); huimin_loan term is 3 years (not 5); large CD minimum is 20万 (not 10万); credit card daily interest is 0.05% (a daily rate, not annual). An agent relying on general banking knowledge or the distractor files will fail multiple checks.
